changes.summary: Lens on phones: a stat tile's header is one row at every width and folds export/expand into a «⋯» menu (new key panel.actions) when the tile is narrow; KPI tiles form a 2×2 grid on a phone; the dashboard freshness label truncates instead of pushing Export onto a second row; horizontal bars hang names above the bars on narrow plots and keep the unit inside the grid; a pie legend folds to a few rows without the per-row eye and bulk controls; the sr-only chart mark buttons no longer overlap; the drill arrow stays beside the figure; the runtime ships built-in Russian (and a Latin Uzbek subset) chrome messages chosen by the document locale, with the host catalogue still winning; compact money carries the host grapheme (FieldFormat.symbol is now set for abbreviated money) so tiles and charts print one currency format.

Mobile app shell: 16px form fields on phones, heading focus and 44px close controls in drawers, shared DrawerHeader/DrawerFooter with inline delete confirmation, global HTMX error toasts and targeted refresh (htmx.RefreshTargets), mobile search, brand and notification panel in the navbar.

Add optional application default language (bootstrap.WithDefaultLanguage) and application time zone (bootstrap.WithTimezone); language-select lists only enabled languages; 404 renders inside the authenticated shell; login keeps the email out of the URL and sets autocomplete; password reveal toggle fixed; localized currency names, filter labels, module/resource labels and browser validation messages; sessions show application-zone time and host-only IPs; profile heading/avatar preview; notification settings layout and checkboxes.

Fix the project edit drawer showing an empty counterparty; accept amounts typed with spaces, no-break spaces and a decimal comma (money.ParseAmount, shared.Amount form type); add core MoneyInput component, field error for CounterpartySelect, responsive acceptance rows and a default document date. ProjectCreateDTO/ProjectUpdateDTO.ContractAmount and AcceptanceCreateDTO.Amount are now shared.Amount.

Release verification after the mobile PRs: the Solid ConfirmationDialog and ViewDrawer follow the templ header (44px drawer-close target, X icon, bottom-safe footer, stacked 44px buttons, bg-surface-300 drawer panel), Solid Dialog keeps the native showModal focus instead of re-focusing the first control (and focuses the heading on phones), ConfirmationDialog gains `danger`; Lens Linux baselines are refreshed for the intentional #1264 mobile-tile and built-in Russian chrome changes; the scaffold select-filter E2E reads the default trigger from TableConfig.ResolvedHxTrigger; the migration connection-release test waits for the server backend to leave pg_stat_activity (#1265); the filters drawer test checks the sheet's own class tokens instead of a substring that depends on twmerge's class order.

Scaffold table on phones: card layout with column mobile roles (WithMobileRole, WithMobileLayout), primary action plus "more" menu in EmbeddedContent, form-scoped hx-trigger with WithoutPushURL/WithPushURL, filter bottom sheet with Apply/Reset, active filter chips, distinct empty states, and unlinked placeholder cells.
